description: Two launches. A rule list whose estimate is between 80% of the limit and Clauseo's ask-mode budget: session/new goes to auto; the first prompt's Edit gets the service blip twice and the turn ends on it, so the client marks the agent to relaunch, and the next prompt loads sess-1 and sends set_mode default (ask mode)

content.text: The server-side auto mode classifier gave no verdict (error), so auto mode cannot determine the safety of Edit. This is a transient failure of the check, not a judgment about the action: a later response may get a verdict. You may try the action again once, as-is. Repeated attempts are slowed by a growing delay, and after 10 responses in a row without a verdict the turn stops.
